name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
benefit: A Financial assistance up to a maximum of ₹30,000/- per year per eligible Ex-Servicemen/widow is provided in a financial year.
_eligibility_text: **The following criteria must be fulfilled:-** - Applicant must be a non-pensioner ESM or his widow. - Should be of rank Havildar/equivalent and below. - Should be recommended by respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB). - Expenditure must be incurred at recognized government hospitals at rates approved under CGHS/ ECHS.
